FASTVC-BENCH-CORPUS:chromium-main-v1-943b94ae-1c74-4335-94fa-ceb4d277cea8
Tests that service workers excluded by Target.setAutoAttach filter are NOT paused on start (crbug.com/482620898). Before the fix, the pause decision was made before filters were evaluated, causing a deadlock where the excluded (session-less) worker never received Runtime.runIfWaitingForDebugger.
